{{Quote|This is a Rebel that surrendered to us. Although he denies it, I believe there may be more of them, and I request permission to conduct a further search of the area.|Commander Igar delivering Luke Skywalker to Darth Vader|audio=Igar-Rebel.flac|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
'''Igar''' served as a Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. He was stationed at the [[Endor/Legends|Sanctuary Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] at the time of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] attack to the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that protected the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|He was armed only with this.''"<br />"''Good work, Commander. Leave us. Conduct your search and bring his companions to me.''"<br />"''Yes, my lord.|Igar and Darth Vader as the former hands the latter Luke Skywalker's lightsaber|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
Igar was born on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Army and attained the rank of Commander. In 3 ABY, he served with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]' [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he was assigned by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to coordinate the surface defense of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="Igar" /> alongside [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]]<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> as part of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. Palpatine planned to trick the Rebels into attacking the incomplete [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], which orbited the Endor moon, by releasing information that showed the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] location. Palpatine hoped the Rebels would send a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] to the forest moon to deactivate the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] shield generator, only for them to be captured by Igar's defenses.<ref name="Episode VI" />

As part of the plan, Igar deployed [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]].<ref name="Outflank">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Outflank}}</ref><ref name="SneakAttack">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sneak Attack}}</ref> He selected the most dedicated stormtroopers to serve him<ref name="EliteSquadronStormtrooper">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Elite Squadron Stormtrooper}}</ref> and he also had a personal honor guard.<ref name="topps">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Threepio's Intrusion}}</ref> Igar served as the commanding officer of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] ''[[Tempest 1]]''.<ref name="Tempest 1">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Tempest 1}}</ref>

[[File:Igar_and_Vader.png|thumb|left|200px|Igar handing Darth Vader Luke Skywalker's lightsaber]]
When a member of the Rebel strike team that Palpatine had lured there, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], surrendered to the Imperial forces, Commander Igar took the prisoner to Lord Vader, and expressed his belief that more Rebels were hidden in the forests, regardless of Skywalker's claims to the contrary. He handed Skywalker's new lightsaber to Vader and returned to ''Tempest 1'' to start his search for the Rebels. Later, when the Rebel commando team infiltrated the shield bunker, Igar and Dyer were expecting them and sent in troops to capture them. Though Dyer was killed in the capture, the Imperials were initially victorious until a [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|tribe]] of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] assisting the Rebels attacked them, resulting in chaos.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in place of Commander Igar, a stormtrooper [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and his men turn over Luke Skywalker to Darth Vader. The captain says the same lines as Igar, and it is he who continues the search for Rebels in the Endor forests.
